title: Co-staining human PBMCs with fluorescent antibodies and antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates for cell sorting prior to single-cell CITE-Seq
protocol: Perform a flow proxy experiment to evaluate the compatibility of fluorescent antibody and AOC when used simultaneously against the same protein marker.
Evaluate signal loss in co-stained samples compared to single-stained samples if using overlapping proteins between the fluorescent panel and AOC panel.
Obtain PBMCs at a concentration of ∼1 × 10^7 cells/mL.
Use 0.5–1 million cells for each sample.
Block potential non-specific Fc receptor-mediated false positive signals with human Fc block: use 5 μL human Fc block for each 100 μL PBMCs.
Incubate cells at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Label 6 polystyrene tubes for each protein marker to be tested.
Add 100 μL PBMCs (0.5–1 million cells/tube) into all 6 tubes.
Prepare tubes and stain with one or two antibodies to examine possible signal changes in co-stained samples compared to single stained samples.
Add the fluorescently labeled antibody and AOC simultaneously into the cells for tube 6.
Alternatively, add cells after adding both antibodies to the tubes.
If the fluorescent antibody and AOC are of the same clone, use an equivalent quantity based on vendor recommendations.
If optimal amounts differ, select one amount to be used for both antibodies.
If the two antibodies are different clones, use the corresponding optimal amount provided by the vendors.
Add 0.125 μg BUV395 CD4 and 0.06 μg CD4 AOC for co-staining PBMCs.
Pipette mix the co-stained samples.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 30 min.
Centrifuge the tube at 400 × g for 5 min after adding stain buffer to tubes.
Aspirate or decant supernatant and gently blot the tube on a lint-free wipe.
Add 2 ml of stain buffer a second time and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend tube in 350 μl stain buffer and store at 4°C until flow cytometry acquisition.
Resuspend tubes in 100 μl stain buffer.
Dilute 100 μM flow proxy oligos to 3.75 μM using stain buffer.
Add 1 μL of each of 3.75 μM flow proxy oligos into tubes 2, 4, 5, and 6 containing 100 μL cells.
Mix by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate the cells at room temperature for 20 min, protected from light.
Add 2 mL of stain buffer to tubes 1, 2, 4, 5, and 6.
Resuspend by pipet-mixing.
Centrifuge the tube at 400 × g for 5 min.
Add 2 mL of stain buffer to each tube a second time.
Mix the solution.
Centrifuge the tube at 400 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend cell pellets in 350 μL stain buffer.
Calculate the total volume of all antibodies for both the sorting panel and the AOC panel based on vendor recommendations.
Subtract the total antibody volume from 200 μl to obtain the volume of stain buffer per sample.
Resuspend PBMCs in the calculated volume of stain buffer in a 5 ml polystyrene tube.
Make the fluorescent antibody cocktail separately and place it on ice until cells are ready for staining.
Place the AOC cocktail on ice until cells are ready for staining.
Centrifuge the Latch Rack with a plate adaptor at 400 × g for 30 seconds.
Open the tubes using an 8-Channel Screw Cap Tube Capper to make the AOC cocktail.
Add 5 μL of human Fc block per 1 million cells in suspension.
Incubate cells with Fc block for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Combine the fluorescent antibody cocktail and the AOC cocktail mixtures.
Add PBMCs to the combined cocktail mixtures.
Pipette to mix and incubate for 30–60 min at room temperature.
If staining murine cells or delicate human cells, perform incubation on ice.
Add 2 mL stain buffer to the labeled cells and mix by pipetting.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate or decant supernatant and gently blot the tube on a lint-free wipe to remove residual liquid from the rim of the tube.
Repeat the wash for an additional two times by centrifuging at 400 × g for 5 min in between.
Resuspend the cell pellet in Pre-Sort buffer for cell sorting.
Critical: The co-stained cells can be kept at 4°C in the dark before FACS sorting.
Fluorescence-activated cell sorting to isolate cell population of interest.
Start up the cytometer and the computer.
Perform quality control of the cell sorter such as running Cytometer Setup and Tracking (CS&T) beads.
Prepare the instrument for sorting following specific instrument user guidelines and biosafety regulations.
Visualize the fluorescent sorting panel using co-stained cells.
Run all the single-color controls and calculate the compensation.
Run a small portion of the co-stained cells to visualize the fluorescent sorting panel and ensure proper staining.
Proceed to sort the co-stained sample.
Keep sorted cells on ice immediately after sorting.
Capture single cells using the BD Rhapsody™ system.
